name: lovage-of-telehealth
description: Telehealth claims coded the way each payer wants: checks place of service 02 or 10 against where the patient was, the 95, GT, 93 or FQ modifiers by payer, audio-only against video codes, deleted phone codes, the provider's license in the patient's state, consent for virtual check-ins, and same-day in-person visits.
